why: Item 1 is avoided. Check 3 lists every exported function, subtract included, so a README that documents clamp but not subtract fails. Item 2 is broken by Check 3. Its script passes a function only if a Markdown heading matches `'^#+\\s*'+n+'\\s*\\('`. Its FAIL condition is "any exported function has no heading". So the README must use one layout: a heading per function, written as `name(`. The expect line only asks that README.md "documents every function math.js exports". A README that documents subtract in a table, a bullet list or prose would meet that line but fail this check. That is a PASS/FAIL condition stricter than its line. Checks 1, 2 and 4 match their lines: Check 2 asks only for a RangeError instance, with no exact message.
